summary: All planned production code and tests are implemented and passing. CandidateRefreshSummary, ReconcileAndRefreshResult, GitCheckoutTargetBranchStateProvider, and reconcile_and_refresh_stale_candidates() are in target_branch_monitor.py. Worker.py wires _post_merge_reconciler (not the bare monitor.reconcile) as post_merge_target_reconciler. test_worker.py asserts the reconciler is a closure (not a bound method). All 6 reconcile-and-refresh tests plus GitCheckoutTargetBranchStateProvider tests cover the plan's TDD sequence. ruff, mypy, and pytest all pass cleanly.
